name: Wedevlops Custom Horizontal Menu
author: WeDevlops

sections.description:
Plugin Overview: Custom Menu Horizontal

Custom Menu Horizontal is a WordPress plugin that allows you to display a stylish, responsive horizontal navigation menu anywhere on your site using a shortcode. It’s ideal for users who want more control over the appearance of their menus without diving deep into theme files or custom coding.

 

Key Features & Functions

  • Horizontal Layout: Displays your WordPress menu in a horizontal format, perfect for headers or inline navigation.

  • Color Customization: Choose custom colors for menu items, hover states, and submenu backgrounds.Only for PRO version

  • Google Fonts Integration: Select from hundreds of Google Fonts to style your menu text. Only for PRO version

  • Submenu Styling: Customize the background and appearance of dropdown/submenus. Only for PRO version

  • Custom CSS Support: Add your own CSS rules to fine-tune the design. Only for PRO version

  • Shortcode-Based: Easily embed the menu in posts, pages, or widgets using `[custom_horizontal_menu]`.

  • LIVE DEMO Click here: Custom Menu or copy and paste the URL – https://wp.wedevlops.com/plugin-overview-custom-menu-horizontal/
